sources.title: NASA Swift re-entry confirmation
sources.publisher: NASA Science / Goddard Space Flight Center.
sources.published_at: original page 2026-11-02; editor update confirming re-entry 2026-11-04.
limitations: NASA says most of the spacecraft was expected to burn up and some components may have survived; this page does not establish a ground impact.

sources.title: Independent Swift re-entry reporting
limitations: secondary report; no independent ground survey of every possible fragment.

sources.title: ESA Space Environment Report 2026
limitations: not a live November 2026 count. Its average of more than three intact satellites or rocket bodies re-entering per day and around ten payloads launched per day describes the report's 2025 data basis. Collision-cascade projections are long-term scenarios, not an imminent event forecast.

sources.title: Satellite Earth-observation applications
limitations: examples include weather forecasting, agriculture, maritime safety, and disaster response; the page does not establish that loss of any single satellite would disable those services in Indonesia.

sources.title: BMKG weekly forecast and hotspot monitoring
limitations: BMKG explicitly states hotspots do not always represent an actual fire. Temperature and rainfall figures are regional observations, not national uniform conditions.

sources.title: BMKG Papua Selatan fire response
limitations: operational update for a defined region; not evidence that all high-confidence hotspots across Indonesia are confirmed fires.

sources.title: GAMBUT peat-fire field experiment
sources.publisher: International Journal of Wildland Fire, 2022, volume 31, issue 10, pages 949–966.
limitations: experimental findings are site- and condition-specific. The 4–10-day observation window must not be presented as a universal duration for peat fires. The paper reports smouldering combustion and lethal biological-system effects in peat to 30 cm depth at the experimental site.

sources.title: Oxford summary of seabird clock-shift study
limitations: findings are species- and route-specific. The release reports navigational deviations up to approximately 15° and a possible internal-clock lag up to around one hour. Health, feeding, and survival consequences were not established.

sources.title: Independent seabird study reporting
limitations: reports that effects on feeding, rest, and broader health have not yet been investigated.

sources.title: Indonesia migratory-waterbird context
limitations: contextual evidence only. It does not show that Manx shearwater clock-shift findings have been observed in Indonesian migratory species.

sources.title: Mars hydrogen-chloride research communication
sources.publisher: Space Research Institute of the Russian Academy of Sciences (IKI RAN).
limitations: possible magmatic source is an interpretation. No observed lava flow or eruption is reported.

sources.title: Independent Mars research reporting
limitations: supports the interpretation as a possibility, not a confirmed eruption or evidence of life.

claims.claim: NASA and the U.S. Space Force confirmed that the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory re-entered the atmosphere on 2026-11-04 at 7:39 a.m. EST (12:39 UTC; 19:39 WIB) over North Sumatra, approximately 3.4° N, 98.6° E.
claims.safe_wording: “Satelit observatorium Swift kembali memasuki atmosfer di atas wilayah Sumatera Utara pada 4 November 2026.”
claims.caveat: re-entry region is approximate; do not infer a precise ground impact point.

claims.claim: most of Swift was expected to burn up during atmospheric re-entry; some components may have survived, while Reuters reported no ground damage or injuries.
claims.safe_wording: “Sebagian besar diperkirakan terbakar; beberapa komponen mungkin bertahan. Tidak ada kerusakan atau korban di darat yang dilaporkan.”
claims.caveat: avoid claiming every fragment's fate is known.

claims.claim: ESA's 2026 report, using data through the end of 2025, reports an average of more than three intact satellites or rocket bodies re-entering per day and around ten new payloads launched daily.
claims.safe_wording: “Laporan ESA berbasis data 2025 mencatat lebih dari tiga objek utuh kembali memasuki atmosfer per hari secara rata-rata.”
claims.caveat: historical annual average, not a live count for 2026-11-05.

claims.claim: collisions can create fragments that trigger further collisions; without mitigation and active debris removal, some orbital regions could become increasingly unsafe or unusable over the long term.
claims.safe_wording: “Dalam skenario jangka panjang, tabrakan berantai dapat membuat sebagian orbit semakin sulit digunakan.”
claims.caveat: not imminent, not inevitable, and not equivalent to all satellites failing simultaneously.

claims.claim: satellite observations support weather forecasting, agricultural decisions, maritime safety, and disaster response.
claims.safe_wording: “Data satelit membantu pemantauan cuaca, pertanian, keselamatan maritim, dan respons bencana.”
claims.caveat: do not imply that losing one satellite would disable these services.

claims.claim: BMKG's 2026-11-05 outlook reports maximum daily temperatures above 37°C in five named provinces during 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-01; high-confidence hotspot detections during the preceding ten days were highest in Papua Selatan (685), Sumatera Selatan (168), and Sulawesi Tenggara (167); smoke was observed in parts of Jambi, Kalimantan Tengah, Maluku, and Papua Selatan.
claims.safe_wording: cite the exact observation period and say “hotspot terdeteksi”, not “kebakaran terkonfirmasi”.
claims.caveat: BMKG explicitly says a hotspot does not always indicate an actual fire; regional rainfall and temperature conditions differ.

claims.claim: BMKG reported ongoing support for karhutla response and flood preparedness in Papua Selatan, with weather-modification operations and a shift toward increased rainfall potential.
claims.safe_wording: “Papua Selatan menghadapi kebutuhan penanganan karhutla sekaligus kesiapsiagaan terhadap hujan dan banjir.”
claims.caveat: specific to Papua Selatan and the operational dates in the report.

claims.claim: peat fires can smoulder without visible flames, persist below the surface, release carbon and toxic gases, and damage peat biological systems at depth. A Sumatra field experiment measured severe thermal effects down to 30 cm in the experimental peat.
claims.safe_wording: “Api gambut dapat membara tanpa nyala besar di permukaan; kedalaman dan lamanya bergantung pada kondisi gambut, air, dan cuaca.”
claims.caveat: do not universalize the experiment's 4–10-day observation window or 30 cm measurement to every peat fire.

claims.claim: rapid eastward homing flights can leave Manx shearwaters' internal clocks behind local solar time by up to around one hour, producing systematic Sun-compass errors; the study reports deviations up to approximately 15°.
claims.safe_wording: “Pada Manx shearwater yang diteliti, pergeseran jam biologis saat terbang cepat ke timur berkaitan dengan kesalahan arah kompas Matahari.”
claims.caveat: do not generalize to all bird species or claim measured health/survival effects.

claims.claim: Indonesia is part of the East Asian–Australasian Flyway and supports a large diversity of waterbirds, including migratory species.
claims.safe_wording: “Indonesia berada di jalur migrasi burung air Asia Timur–Australasia.”
claims.caveat: this does not prove the Manx shearwater clock-shift mechanism occurs in Indonesian species.

claims.claim: the ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter's ACS instrument detected hydrogen chloride with an unusual seasonal and geographic pattern near Alba Mons.
claims.safe_wording: “Peneliti melaporkan pola gas hidrogen klorida yang terlokalisasi di atas wilayah Alba Mons.”
claims.caveat: detection is not itself a direct observation of an eruption.

claims.claim: researchers interpret the localized hydrogen-chloride signal and nearby fissures as potentially consistent with magmatic gas seepage from below the surface.
claims.safe_wording: “Temuan ini mengisyaratkan kemungkinan sumber magmatik di bawah permukaan Mars.”
claims.caveat: no active lava flow or eruption was observed; no evidence of life was found.
